title: The Wheel Desk · Friday gamma read, Oct 2
tape: The default CSP screen returned 13 names, and 7 are bitcoin miners in two correlation clusters: CIFR, CLSK, WULF, CORZ, IREN in one, MARA and RIOT in the other (MARA to CLSK is 0.86 anyway). Treat it
The miners are down 9.5% (WULF) to 18.4% (RIOT) over five days. Nothing in the group is selling tonight.
IV rank is under 7 on 8 of 13 names (52-week CBOE rank). Only SMCI (33) and MAT (100) are above 20.
The screen priced MAT at 15.04, but the chart closed it at 12.66. The 14 put it calls 6.9% out of the money is actually in the money.
No name on tonight's screen has an earnings date inside expiry on the TMPro calendar, but that calendar stops at Oct 30. SMCI, SMR and ONDS expire after it.
Gamma scan: 18 of 25 names are in positive dealer gamma (pinning), 7 in negative (moves get amplified).

methodology: Every name starts from TraderMatrix screens run at default settings, then gets graded by the desk independently of the screen's own score. Four gates: cushion (breakeven vs recent real support), chart health (trend vs the 50/200, lower lows), IV context (rank vs its own history, not just the raw number), and liquidity (quote width, open interest at the strike). Names that move together (60-day return correlation) count as one bet, so only the best of a cluster can be a Sell. Fund option positions come from daily income-ETF holdings files: they are income overlays, not directional calls. Passed names stay on the board with the reason. Education, not advice: verify the live chain and use limit orders.
